item.title: What Is a Developer
item.description:
What Is a Developer #

Developers (Devs) are responsible for implementing the backlog and building the product. They also give input on technical aspects when solutions are being considered, playing a part in the team’s understanding and decision-making. The basic approach to development follows Twelve-Factor .

Within a balanced team, they contribute to the product’s success by bringing the perspective of Feasible (technical feasibility) through the Extreme Programming methodology.
